item.title: fix(config): use real newline in invalid-config log message (#119871)
item.summary: fix(config): use real newline in invalid-config log message (#119871) formatInvalidConfigLogMessage used \\n (literal backslash-n) in a template literal, producing literal text instead of a line break in gateway startup logs. The sibling createInvalidConfigError already used a real newline. Operators saw a single-line message with \n text instead of a readable multi-line block. Fixes #119870 Co-authored-by: ruel225
